description: 30 Day Generation Mix Northeast is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. Our 30 Day Generation Mix Northeast dataset provides information on the breakdown of generation technologies within our Northeast licence area. The dataset provides half hourly data in a 30 day window, with values for each generation type along with a demand and generation total, as well as the Carbon Intensity for the whole licence area. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Net Zero Future. Its keywords are National Grid, Low Carbon Technologies (LCT), Generation, Live Data. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
